after_notes: The current production firmware schedules upstream-aligned fan modes and PID decisions at 100 ms behind the admitted active-campaign gate and existing typed single-owner I2C queue. The closed Ultra 205 PWR-002 hardware regression proves a typed 100% fan command before voltage and a fresh nonzero post-command RPM, followed by successful initialized work, accepted submit, safe stop, cleanup, no rerun, independent validation, and redaction. See [THR-002 result](work-plans/20260813T024957Z-THR-002/RESULT.md) and [closed projection](evidence/pwr002-asic-power-initialization/power-initialization-projection.json). Analog RPM accuracy, a complete dynamic curve, closed-loop settling, soak, arbitrary hardware duties, injected fan faults, physical-fault recovery, overheat behavior, other boards, and other controllers remain non-claims. Later soak evidence (ADR-0037), outside the projection above, narrows the closed-loop-settling and soak non-claims for these cases only: under the automatic fan setting with a 60 C target, the chip settled at about 60 C, within 35-61 C overall, at 2,420-5,775 RPM during 600 s soaks at 485 and 575 MHz ([soak 007](evidence/20261016-ultra205-soak-007.md), [soak 009](evidence/20261016-ultra205-soak-009.md)); a third soak peaked at 60 C and ran 53-56 C once settled at 400 MHz ([soak 008](evidence/20261016-ultra205-soak-008.md)). Tuning quality, faults, overheat behavior and the remaining non-claims above still apply.
